Slay a [[Gargoyle]] [[boss]] playing pretend as a [[mesmer]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = mesmer
}}

===Objectives===
* Go to the ruins of [[Ashford]] and defeat [[Ignis Phanaura]].
* Return to [[Vassar]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 200 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Conjure Phantasm}}
* {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Imagined Burden}}
* {{skill icon|Power Leak}}

==Walkthrough==
You will find Ignis Phanaura just south of the [[Sardelac Sanitarium]] alongside two additional gargoyles. When accompanied by [[Henchman|henchmen]] or in a [[Party|group]], they shouldn't pose much of a threat. Beware of Ignis's [[Chaos Storm]], which can deal a significant hit to both your [[Health]] and [[Energy]] over time. When you see him cast it, change your position to avoid the area damage.

Destroy him and the people of [[Ascalon]] will benefit greatly from your actions."''
